children: CBOT corn futures are now in positive territory, as traders eye the building of long positions in the market. On Friday, the CFTC reported managed money held a net long position of just over 376,500 contracts, which includes the addition of 89,470 longs for the week ended Aug. 25. "Friday's COT showed massive fund buying in corn," says AgMarket.net in a note. Most-active corn rises 0.1%, while soybeans climb 0.2% but wheat is down 2.9%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
